adjudication.rationale: `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` calls `URI(@embed_url).host` and only rescues `URI::InvalidURIError`. Since `@embed_url` ultimately comes from user-controlled input (`EmbedController#best` takes `params.require(:embed_url)` and enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` with it), any unrescued exception raised by `URI(...)` would bubble up and can crash retrieval/job execution rather than treating the URL as invalid. The code’s intent (comment: “An invalid URI is an invalid host”) suggests it should defensively handle other parse errors as well, but it currently does not.
